jobs.prompt:
Delta review of train 9 tin 1 (one board owner) after the blocker you found in the first review (head 188c2fb9, verdict fail). The fixed combined diff is in context at coordination/review/t9-tin1.diff; evidence is in t9-tin1-evidence.json. Full suite after the fix: 7672 tests, 7641 pass, 0 fail; focused 54/54.

The blocker was: the launchd restart branch in tools/server-restart.mjs was taken for every old-version board work item whenever the plist existed and `launchctl print` reported running, without tying the record to the launchd job or limiting kickstart to once. That could kickstart launchd for a stray board on another port, poll the wrong port and report failed, and double-kickstart when the registry and discovery both named the board (killing the just-updated board).

The fix (4ae2e783): read the keep-up identity once per call; parse the launchd pid; take the launchd path only when identity.port === record.port OR launchdPid === record.pid; a per-call `launchdKicked` guard runs kickstart at most once and skips duplicate launchd items; the launchd-not-loaded busy-port skip now requires !loaded, so a stray board falls through to the normal manual/terminal path. Tests added: stray record on another port => zero kickstarts and the manual/terminal path; registry + discovered board => exactly one kickstart; stale record pid with matching identity port => one kickstart; existing launchd tests kept.

Also re-check the earlier followups: (a) boardAnswers probes token-free /api/health and no longer validates the token it prints; (b) success is confirmed only by the version at record.port, the health pid is ignored; (c) the unloaded-job busy-port check. Say whether each is now addressed or remains a followup; only real blockers fail the bar. Re-check the watch --all reuse path and the full diff for regressions. Report only real findings with file and line, a concrete failure, and a fix.

Write ONLY coordination/review/t9-tin1-review.json: {"verdict":"pass"|"fail","score":0-10,"blockers":[{"file":"","line":0,"problem":"","exploit_or_failure":"","fix":""}],"followups":[same shape],"summary":""}. verdict is fail only if blockers is non-empty. The runner stamps the reviewed head; do NOT add or change a head field.
